items.title: Iran condemns US strikes as 'gross violation' of ceasefire
items.description: The attacks took place while Iranian and Qatari negotiators were in Doha for peace talks.

items.title: Russia threatens more Kyiv strikes and tells foreign nationals to leave
items.description: It comes after the Ukrainian capital suffered one of the biggest aerial assaults of the war overnight on Saturday.

items.title: Four killed as school minibus collides with train in Belgium
items.description: Two schoolchildren, their chaperone and the minibus driver were killed in the crash, says a Belgian minister.

items.title: Eleven killed in Lebanon village as Israel intensifies strikes
items.description: Israel says it struck 100 Hezbollah infrastructure sites and fighters in Lebanon, after PM Benjamin Netanyahu vows to "crush" Hezbollah.

items.title: Why temperature records are being not only broken but smashed
items.description: The combined effects of a heat dome and climate change have brought extreme warmth to western Europe.

items.title: Ebola needs swift response to prevent catastrophe, says DR Congo governor
items.description: The governor of Ituri said the more time they lose, the closer the province is to disaster.

items.title: Australia confirms first diphtheria death amid worst outbreak in decades
items.description: Most cases are in the Northern Territory with some also in Western Australia, South Australia and Queensland.

items.title: Internet starts coming back in Iran after months-long blackout
items.description: Internet access has been cut off in the country since the start of the war in late February.

items.title: China executes man for poisoning billionaire gaming tycoon
items.description: The court said the man poisoned the tycoon for sidelining him after he helped secure a deal with Netflix for the 3 Body Problem.

items.title: South African president mounts legal challenge against report that could lead to impeachment
items.description: Cyril Ramaphosa argues that the authors of the report "misconceived" their mandate.

items.title: Rescuers race to free seven people trapped in flooded Laos cave
items.description: A team of experts who helped free a teen football team from a Thai cave in 2018 are among the rescuers.

items.title: Rights group accuses UAE of being transit point for mercenaries on way to Sudan
items.description: The United Arab Emirates has denied any involvement in the civil war and says it investigates alleged links.
